violations.description: Food supplies. — --Food item obtained from unapproved source. Uninspected frozen ground beef stored in chest freezer with items used in food service for establishment. Store "personal-use" items at home.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Walls and ceiling tiles discoloring from multiple pizza ovens being used without adequate ventilation.
Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. 3 tub sink drain line to grease trap leaking. Needs repair.
